segments.name: Midwest & South
segments.description: Operates casino resorts in Illinois, Mississippi and Indiana serving nearby residents and drive-in tourists.

segments.name: Contracted Sports Wagering
segments.description: Licenses sports wagering skins in Colorado, Indiana and Illinois to outside operators for a percentage of revenues.
segments.evidence: We historically have contracted with outside companies to operate such skins under their own brands in exchange for a percentage of revenues, as defined in each contract, subject to annual minimum amounts.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for casino gaming, hotel stays, food and beverage and other amenities, while sports wagering operators pay a percentage of revenues under skin contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: We seek to increase revenues by providing our customers with their favorite games and amenities, high-quality customer service, and appropriate customer loyalty programs.

changes.text: In 2024, the company completed the phased opening of Chamonix, its newest property adjacent to Bronco Billy's Casino.
changes.evidence: In October 2024, we completed the phased opening of Chamonix, our newest property, located adjacent to our existing Bronco Billy's Casino.
